Submit a Route
The school has identified
and submitted an official
route for Safe Routes to
School.

Biking to School
The school supported the
development of a “Bike
Bus”, or incentivized
biking to school.

Crossing Guards
The school participates in
the Deferred Disposition
for School Zone Citations
Community Service
Program.

Incentivized Walking
The school held a contest
or incentivized walking to
school for students.

Teach Bicycle and
Pedestrian Safety in
School
The school ensured all
students received some
form of education
regarding bicycle and
pedestrian safety.

Walking to School
The school held a “Walk to
School Day” or encouraged
the organization of a
“Walking School Bus.”

Bike to School Day or
Bike Rodeo
The school held a “Bike to
School” Day or the school
hosted or participated in a
“Bike Rodeo”.

Park a Block and Walk A
Block
The school has designated
an area for a “Park a Block
and Walk a Block”
Program.

Host a Walk Audit
The school held a walk
audit or submitted walk
audit feedback to the City.
